clinicalPearls: Clusters plus catalase plus coagulase is aureus
Preformed toxin vomits in hours; TSS shocks with desquamation
mecA means PBP2a: beta lactams fail
Biofilm on hardware: remove the device
reference.pathophysiology: Protein A and capsule block opsonophagocytosis while coagulase walls off abscesses with fibrin; superantigens clamp MHC-II to T cell receptors firing polyclonal cytokine storms, and PBP2a keeps crosslinking peptidoglycan under beta lactam siege.
additionalDifferentials: Scalded skin versus TEN by mucosal sparing and age
TSS versus septic shock by rash with desquamation
MRSA versus MSSA by oxacillin screen and mecA
additionalInvestigations: Catalase, slide and tube coagulase with mannitol salt agar
Blood cultures with mecA PCR and vancomycin MIC
Nasal screening with mupirocin decolonisation protocol
